{"code": "import collections
import urllib.request

def solve():
    url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dolph/dictionary/master/enable1.txt"
    response = urllib.request.urlopen(url)
    words = response.read().decode().split()
    word_set = set(w.upper() for w in words if len(w) == 4)
    start, end = 'WHOA', 'LUTE'
    word_set.add(start); word_set.add(end)
    queue = collections.deque([(start, [start])])
    visited = {start}
    while queue:
        curr, path = queue.popleft()
        if curr == end: return path
        for i in range(4):
            for char in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ':
                next_word = curr[:i] + char + curr[i+1:]
                if next_word in word_set and next_word not in visited:
                    visited.add(next_word)
                    queue.append((next_word, path + [next_word]))
    return "No path"

path = solve()
print(path)
for i in range(len(path)-1):
    w1, w2 = path[i], path[i+1]
    diffs = [j for j in range(4) if w1[j] != w2[j]]
    print(f"{w1} -> {w2} diff indices: {diffs}")"}
